2.modern-en: Urges Polixenes to extend his visit, then becomes suddenly convinced that Hermione and Polixenes are lovers. Orders Camillo to poison Polixenes.

3.modern-en: Publicly accuses Hermione of adultery and orders her imprisoned. Sends messengers to the Oracle at Delphi for confirmation.

5.modern-en: Refuses to acknowledge the newborn Perdita as his child. Orders Antigonus to abandon the baby in the wilderness.

7.modern-en: Puts Hermione on trial. The Oracle declares her innocent; Leontes rejects it. His son Mamillius dies; Hermione collapses. Leontes recognizes what he has done and vows lifelong penance.

13.modern-en: Reappears after sixteen years of mourning. Paulina holds him to his vow never to remarry. Learns that Florizel and Perdita have arrived in Sicilia.

15.modern-en: Views the statue of Hermione in Paulina's gallery. When it moves, he embraces her. Reunited with his wife and his lost daughter.

2.modern-en: Persuades Polixenes to stay longer at Leontes's request, then is accused by her husband of infidelity.

3.modern-en: Arrested and taken to prison while pregnant. Gives birth to Perdita in captivity.

7.modern-en: Stands trial for adultery. Delivers a dignified defense of her innocence. Collapses when told of Mamillius's death and is reported dead.

15.modern-en: Revealed as the statue in Paulina's gallery. Steps down from the pedestal and embraces Leontes, ending sixteen years of separation.

12.modern-en: Presides as queen of the sheep-shearing festival, courted by Florizel. Distributes flowers to guests. When Polixenes reveals himself and forbids the match, she flees with Florizel to Sicilia.

13.modern-en: Arrives in Sicilia with Florizel. Her identity as Leontes's daughter is discovered.

15.modern-en: Reunited with her mother Hermione in the statue scene.

4.modern-en: Visits Hermione in prison and takes the newborn Perdita to present to Leontes, hoping to soften his heart.

5.modern-en: Confronts Leontes with the baby, defying him to his face. Leontes orders the child abandoned despite her protests.

7.modern-en: Announces Hermione's death and forces Leontes to face the full weight of what he has done.

13.modern-en: Continues to hold Leontes to his penance, reminding him of Hermione and forbidding him to remarry.

15.modern-en: Orchestrates the statue scene, commanding Hermione to descend from the pedestal. Reunites the royal family.

11.modern-en: Appears on a road near the shepherd's cottage, singing and picking the Clown's pocket by pretending to have been robbed.

12.modern-en: Works the sheep-shearing festival, selling ballads and trinkets while relieving purses. Helps Florizel and Perdita escape by exchanging clothes with Florizel.

14.modern-en: Encounters the Shepherd and Clown on their way to reveal Perdita's origins. Redirects them, inadvertently contributing to the resolution.
